label: Website relaunched — analytics tag missing
detail: The new site shipped without the GA4 tag. Sessions and pageviews read zero from this date until tracking was restored on 2026-08-07. Those zeros are missing measurement, not lost traffic.

label: Analytics restored; follower tracking begins
detail: GA4 tracking fixed. Bluesky, Instagram and Facebook follower counts recorded for the first time — none of these networks publish history, so the series starts here and grows forward.
